A. 9.875e-04
B. 9.871e-04
C. 9.872e-04
D. 9.869e-04

Use tools as needed for PHREEQC / quantitative work.

{"path": "transport_problem.pqi", "new_content": "TITLE 1D Transport with Exchange - 10 cells, 10 shifts

# Initial solution (solution 1-10): pH 7.0, Ca 1.0 mmol/L, Cl 2.0 mmol/L
SOLUTION 1-10
    pH      7.0
    Ca      1.0
    Cl      2.0
    units   mmol/L

# Infilling solution (solution 0): pH 7.0, Na 1.0 mmol/L, Cl 1.0 mmol/L
SOLUTION 0
    pH      7.0
    Na      1.0
    Cl      1.0
    units   mmol/L

# Exchange sites for all 10 cells: 0.001 moles, equilibrate with solution 1
EXCHANGE 1-10
    X       0.001
    -equilibrate 1

TRANSPORT
    -cells          10
    -shifts         10
    -flow_direction forward
    -boundary_conditions flux flux
    -diffusion_coefficient 0.0
    -dispersivity      0.0
    -time_step         1.0
    -length            1.0

SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -file           transport_out.sel
    -reset          false
    -solution       true
    -step           true
    -totals         Na Ca Cl

END
"}
